changes: Improved: PASS, FAIL and N/A result buttons now show as solid coloured pills — green for pass, red for fail, grey for N/A — making it easy to see results at a glance without reading every line.
Improved: Fire alarm outcome buttons now colour up when selected — green for Satisfactory, red for Unsatisfactory, amber for Requires Attention.
Improved: Fire alarm defects condition chips now show in colour — green, amber, and red matching the severity.

New: When you click Continue after entering test results with any failures, the Defects page is automatically pre-filled with a recommended defect entry for each failed device or test — you can edit or remove them.
Improved: Add Defect button has a cleaner, more polished style.
